request.question: Is claim TC-2026-58114 covered under Section 2 (Trip Cancellation) of the policy as endorsed, i.e. should the forfeited trip cost be reimbursed?

options.description: true: The cancellation is for a covered reason and no exclusion applies, so it is covered.
false: The claim is excluded (e.g. Pre-existing Condition without waiver) or otherwise not covered.
